description: List the personal data (PII) found in text, with entity types and positions, without changing the text. Max 5,000 characters.

country.description: Country and regulation as "regulation|country|sub-region|language", e.g. "UK GDPR|United Kingdom||en". Use list_countries to see valid values. Defaults to the first country in the account plan.

selectedEntities.description: Only process these entity types (e.g. EMAIL_ADDRESS)
